answer.answer: Proposed, not booked: an 11-night family trip from August 14–25. Base in Vevey/Montreux through August 21, collect Radley at Milano Malpensa, spend three nights in Stresa/Baveno, and finish with one night in Milan.

claims.value: Use Vevey/Montreux as the single Swiss-side base from August 14–21. It is low altitude, lakefront, and about 1 hour 50 minutes by car from Saas-Fee, providing a practical descent/return fallback during the family's first days nearby without repeating the alpine-resort experience. Choose lodging with space for Radley if an altitude problem requires him to join the family.

Assume pickup at Milano Malpensa Airport on August 21, matching the camp's scheduled Saas-Fee-to-MXP transfer; possible morning make-up training means the rendezvous time remains to be confirmed. From MXP, go directly to Stresa/Baveno on Lake Maggiore for August 21–24, then Milan for August 24–25. This gives the reunited family a four-night Italy finish with only one hotel change and an airport-friendly final night.

The proposed family trip is August 14–25: 11 nights, within the preference of no more than about two weeks. Its rhythm is seven nights in one low-altitude Lake Geneva base, followed by three nights on Lake Maggiore and one night in Milan. It avoids a chain of similar mountain towns; do not add Interlaken, Como, Orta, or another alpine base unless the family deliberately trades simplicity for another move.

This is an active planning scenario, not a booking, and no live prices or availability have been verified. Next confirm the August 21 MXP handoff time, terminal, ski-bag transfer, and whether possible morning make-up training affects arrival; then price cancellable lodging in Vevey/Montreux, Stresa/Baveno, and Milan, verify an extra bed or sofa where needed, compare family open-jaw flights, and check Swiss-to-Italian one-way rental-car fees, insurance, parking, and Milan ZTL implications.

answer.answer: Straylight is a user-owned, portable agent context and durable-work layer for machine continuity. The correction expands its boundary from learned memory and retrieval to resumable work state, source-grounded reasoning, verification, revision, checkpointing, and handoff. Obsidian is a prototype corpus and human-readable projection, not the canonical product surface. The next evaluation must therefore test whether fresh agents can correctly resume and advance representative real work—not merely retrieve evidence.

claims.value: Straylight’s correct product category is a user-owned, portable agent context and durable-work layer: an agent-first product and protocol for durable machine continuity across agent ecosystems. It is not primarily a notes app, wiki, transcript archive, synchronized folder, retrieval product, or memory database.

Beyond durable knowledge and learned patterns, Straylight must preserve the live, resumable state of work: goals, current state, evidence, decisions, hypotheses, plans, artifacts and their canonical versions, computations, unresolved questions, rejected paths, checkpoints, blockers, pending decisions, and the next safe actions. A later agent must be able to inspect how that state was reached, verify or revise it, advance the work, and leave a better durable state behind.

Obsidian and Markdown are useful prototype corpora, human-readable projections, inspection surfaces, and export formats, but they are not Straylight’s canonical product boundary, storage representation, or interaction model. Metis organizes the human knowledge base and supplies the first representative corpus; Straylight is the agent-first context and durable-work product built to operate across vendors, devices, runtimes, and user-chosen trust domains, with full source and artifact access rather than raw notes defining the system.

The first benchmark was too narrow because it evaluated retrieval readiness rather than the full product: it used 44 non-private notes, 20 questions, and 53 gold evidence items, and exercised memory.open, memory.query, and memory.read while leaving model-directed memory.compute and memory.verify untested. Tuned workspace policy 0.2 tied one-shot top-k at 17 of 20 cases but recovered 46 of 53 evidence items versus 48 of 53, while using about 2,932 versus 1,070 mean estimated tokens; consequently, the workspace justification gate was not cleared and retrieval-only scoring is now only a regression lane. The expanded gate must use blinded, untouched cases to compare model-directed open, query, read, compute, verify, checkpoint, and revision behavior against direct filesystem tools and fixed handoff/context packs. It must prove that a fresh agent can resume, iterate after constraints change, inspect complete sources, reason over temporal changes and contradictions, perform quantitative artifact work, verify before acting, advance the work, and leave correct durable next-state artifacts and handoffs across Warmind/Charlemagne performance and incident work, StarRupture factory planning, Switzerland trip planning, and Straylight’s own evolution. That expanded evaluation is defined but not yet completed in the available evidence.

checkpoint.objective: Resume Straylight after the product-framing correction and preserve the corrected product category, durable-work scope, Obsidian relationship, and expanded evaluation gate for the next agent.
current_state: Current fact: Straylight is a user-owned, portable agent context and durable-work layer, not primarily a notes or retrieval product.

Current fact: its durable state includes learned knowledge plus goals, evidence, decisions, hypotheses, plans, artifacts, computations, unresolved questions, rejected paths, checkpoints, current state, and resumable next actions.
Historical verified result: policy 0.2 tied one-shot top-k on 17 of 20 cases but recovered 46 of 53 evidence items versus 48 of 53 and used about 2,932 versus 1,070 mean estimated tokens.
Incomplete work: the expanded real-agent-work evaluation is specified, but the available evidence contains no completed results.
decisions: Obsidian and Markdown remain prototype corpora, projections, and export formats rather than the canonical product boundary.
Retrieval-only scoring is a regression lane; successful continuation and advancement of real work is the primary product gate.
The expanded comparison must cover model-directed workspace calls, direct filesystem tools, and fixed handoff/context packs.
open_questions: Whether model-directed workspace calls outperform controls on blinded, untouched holdout cases by enough to justify their additional calls and context cost remains unresolved.
next_actions: Run the expanded evaluation on Warmind/Charlemagne, StarRupture, Switzerland trip planning, and Straylight workloads.
Measure resumption, iteration, computation, source fidelity, temporal and contradiction reasoning, verification before action, and durable checkpoint/revision/handoff quality.
